description: A climate case of Spanish cedar behind smoked glass, held at seventy percent by a fan you can only just hear. Cigars lie in rows on the racks, and a carriage at the back fills every gap you leave. A card slot by the handle has to be paid before the door opens.

flags.vend_line: The slot takes your card, the lock lets go with a breath of cool air, and you lift a cigar off the rack. Behind the glass, the carriage slides another into its place.

name: cigar humidor
